guides.creator: thedeoxen
guides.description: Moves a subject into the pose and composition of a depth map while drawing its appearance from a reference image.

guide.Inputs: Depth image first, appearance image second. This needs a prepared depth guide, not just a text description.
guide.Image model settings: The author's card suggests about 50 steps and CFG 4 for Base. Foundry's separate guided-angle recipe uses the supplied example graph's 20 steps and CFG 5; keep the complete recipe together.
guide.Watch for: Large differences in scale or proportions between the depth map and reference can damage the result. Use the 4B Base model.

guides.creator: thedeoxen
guides.description: Uses a depth map to guide pose and structure, with a second image supplying the subject's appearance.

guide.Inputs: Depth image first, appearance image second. Prepare the depth image before choosing this adapter.
guide.Image model settings: The model card suggests about 50 steps and CFG 4 for Base. Foundry's guided-angle recipe has its own complete settings.
guide.Watch for: Keep object scale and proportions similar across the two inputs. This is the 9B Base adapter, not the 4B version.

guides.creator: lilylilith
guides.description: Transfers a camera view from a rough 3D render to an original image while trying to retain its visual style.

guide.Inputs: An original image plus a coarse color render at the desired camera angle. Foundry's guided-angle route supplies those roles; selecting this LoRA alone does not create the render.
guide.Image model settings: CFG 3 and at least 20 steps. Use the author's edit instruction and the documented reference ordering.
guide.Watch for: A badly shaped coarse model, deformed faces, or low-resolution inputs can transfer those problems into the result.

guides.creator: akhaliq
guides.description: Changes an object's camera view from a reference photo using named azimuth and elevation labels. This is the v2 step-1500 adapter.

guide.Inputs: One clear reference image and an angle instruction.
guide.Watch for: Use the named camera labels in the source guide. Arbitrary numerical angles are not parsed. Training used 512-pixel images; exact geometry and camera pose still need review.

guides.creator: fal
guides.description: Re-angles a reference image using a vocabulary of viewpoints, elevations, and framing distances.

guide.Inputs: A reference image with a clear subject and an angle instruction.
guide.Example: <sks> back view eye-level shot medium shot
guide.Camera choices: Eight directions, four elevations including low-angle, and three framing distances. The source page lists the supported phrases.
guide.Watch for: Use Qwen Edit 2511. This is different from the Qwen Image 2.1 adapter and its <mva> syntax. Generated viewpoints remain estimates.

guides.creator: akhaliq
guides.description: Re-renders a reference subject from another camera position using named directions and elevations.

guide.Inputs: A reference image plus a raw angle instruction. The published workflow disables prompt upsampling.
guide.Image model settings: The author uses the undistilled Base model and 50 steps. A separate strength recommendation is not published.
guide.Watch for: Trained on synthetic renders. The author reports that some ordinary objects can be replaced by invented subjects or scenes. Check identity carefully.

guides.creator: Alexali
guides.description: An experimental angle adapter distributed for the Klein 9B family. Its tensors match this family, but the publisher's model card is empty.

guide.Published guidance: No verified trigger phrase, strength recommendation, input ordering, or usage instructions are available from the publisher.
guide.Watch for: Foundry's default strength is 1.0, not an author recommendation. Treat camera accuracy and behavior across variants as unverified; inspect the result before using it.

guides.creator: nerijs
guides.description: Gives generated images a pixel-art appearance, suitable for stylized concept images and game-art references.

guide.Prompt: The author says no trigger word is required. Describe the subject normally.
guide.Image model settings: Use your SDXL settings. The source's 8-step, CFG 1.5 and strength 1.2 example also uses a separate LCM adapter; those are not generic settings for this LoRA alone.
guide.Finishing: The author suggests reducing image dimensions by eight with nearest-neighbor resampling for crisp pixel blocks.
guide.Watch for: This styles the image; it does not create pixel geometry or guarantee a particular mesh style.

guides.name: klein4-paper-diorama.safetensors
guides.creator: rehan-fal
guides.description: Creates a miniature paper-diorama look with a crafted, layered-paper appearance.

guide.Prompt: Put the trigger phrase at the beginning, followed by your subject description.
guide.Strength: About 1.0 is the author's serving recommendation; the examples also compare 0.7.
guide.Image model settings: Distilled Klein 4B, 4 steps. It was trained on Base 4B for use with the distilled model.
guide.Watch for: This is an appearance adapter. Folded-paper details in the image may influence the reconstructed shape.

guides.name: klein9-arcane-style.safetensors
guides.creator: DeverStyle
guides.description: Applies an Arcane-inspired illustrated style to newly generated images or reference-image edits.

guide.Prompt: Include the trigger phrase. For an edit, ask to transform the image into that style and state what should stay unchanged.
guide.Image model settings: The author specifies distilled Klein 9B. A strength recommendation is not published; Foundry starts at 1.0.
guide.Watch for: Editing can change the original pose or details. Review the image before preparing it for 3D.

guides.name: flux3-distilled-photo-aesthetics.safetensors
guides.creator: SimpleTuner
guides.license: Other — see source and base-model terms
guides.description: A photographic-aesthetics adaptation for the distilled FLUX 3 Image Klein model. This local file matches the 1024 v2 Kohaku-FA release.

guide.Image model settings: Published validation: 16 steps, CFG 1.0, 512- or 1024-pixel images.
guide.Prompt and strength: No required trigger or separate strength recommendation is published. Foundry's initial strength is 1.0.
guide.Watch for: This changes image appearance. It does not add camera measurements, multiview fusion, or mesh reconstruction.
